fields.name: program deck slots
fields.meaning: 12 deck slots; each holds the number of the folder entry placed there, FF = empty. Slot 0 is empty; slots 1 and 2 hold the two chips shown on the program deck screen
fields.evidence: code 6264:06e1 init FF, 6264:071a set, 6264:073e get; swapping two folder chips rewrote slots 1/2 00,01 -> 01,00 (writer 6264:0738) (RAM f37e)

fields.name: chip folder
fields.meaning: 30 entries of 2 bytes: chip id, then the deck slot that entry is placed in (FF = none). Empty entries are 00 FF. Played save: cannon, shotgun, cannon, shotgun, mini bomb, sword, recovery 50 (7 chips, as on screen)
fields.evidence: code 6264:07c8 init 30 entries; folder screen lists the same 7 chips in order; swapping first two chips swapped pairs 01 01 / 04 02 (writers 6264:0ab5/0ac6) (RAM f38a)

fields.name: folder bytes

fields.name: chip collection
fields.meaning: One byte per chip id 0-248: bit 7 = chip seen (counts toward the Data Library), bits 0-6 = number owned (max 9, max 1 for ids 200 and up). Played save: cannon(1) and shotgun(4) seen x2, mini bomb(16), sword(23), recovery 50(119) seen x1
fields.evidence: code 6264:016a (count+1 and set bit 7), 6264:0189 (seen bit), 6264:01bc (count), 6264:01da (add chip, caps 9/1), 6264:0196 clear; matches the folder (RAM f3ca)

fields.name: money
fields.meaning: Money displayed in zenny; stored in hundreds of zenny (value 25 displays 2,500Z). Native clones tested 2,500Z and 5,000Z through the PET screen. No upper semantic bound is claimed from these trials.
fields.evidence: Display multiplies the stored value by 100 at 2000:960E; the natural field 0x001E displays 3,000Z. Native clones loaded 0x0019 (2,500Z) and 0x0032 (5,000Z); RAM copy F7CE and menu readers 20CD:07C2/295B:0062/008D observed. Trials changed SRAM copy A only at 0x245E and repaired copy-A checksum at 0x2004 (sum16 over 0x200C..0x2471); copy B field/checksum at 0x145E/0x1004 remained byte-identical. Both clones completed without crash/hang; this establishes load/display behavior, not all writer sources or limits.
